/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-9-> [!NOTE]
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-10->
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-11-> The upcoming SDK 10, CLI 6, and Vitest 0.3 releases require an MCPJam login or `sk_` AP
I key for every eval, including BYOK runs with uploads disabled. These versions must ship after the backend run-start endpoint is
deployed. Earlier versions keep their existing behavior.
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-12-
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md:13:`mcpjam test <file>` runs an MCPJam suite file locally: it connects your MCP servers, dri
ves each case's prompts through a model, grades the transcript with the same assertions a hosted run uses, and decides the run wit
h the same verdict policy. Bring your own provider key and authenticate the run with MCPJam. With MCPJam-hosted inference it uses
your existing CLI login and billing.
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-14-
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-15-Results are **never uploaded**. The command writes results to your terminal and, if you a
sk, to a report file. It records the run start with MCPJam. Like every command, it sends the CLI's single anonymous [telemetry](ht
tps://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/telemetry.md) event, which `--no-telemetry` or `DO_NOT_TRACK=1` turns off; the run adds no telemetry of
its own.
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-16-
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-17-## Eval identity and local data
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-132-| `byok` | `mcpjam/…` | refused — the prefix is explicit routing intent |
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-133-| `byok` | `provider/model` | BYOK; the provider key is required |
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-134-| `mcpjam` | `provider/model` | MCPJam; the model must be one MCPJam serves |
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-135-
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md:136:There is no fallback: a key the provider rejects is a credential failure (exit `3`), nev
er a reason to spend platform credits instead.
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-137-
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-138-BYOK keys are read from the standard variables: `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `
GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY` (or `GEMINI_API_KEY`), `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`, `MISTRAL_API_KEY`, `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`, `XAI_API_KEY`. `
ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`, `OPENAI_BASE_URL` and `OLLAMA_BASE_URL` point a provider at a gateway or proxy.
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-139-
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md:140:MCPJam-hosted inference uses the Cloud credential precedence (`--api-key` > `MCPJAM_API_
KEY` > `mcpjam cloud login`) and project precedence (`--project` > `MCPJAM_PROJECT` > `mcpjam cloud link` > most recently updated)
, plus `--api-url` / `--api-header`. The platform is contacted only when a selected case needs it. Hosted inference still makes in
ference and billing requests; "no upload" means no eval results or artifacts are ever sent.
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-141-
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-142-## Hosts
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-143-
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-144-`--host <template>` emulates one existing host template — its `initialize` identity, adv
ertised capabilities, protocol versions and tool visibility, plus its model settings where the suite does not set them. It never l
aunches the real client, and reports say "emulated". The suite's model, and any authored `systemPrompt` / `temperature`, win over
the template's. `target.hosts` in the file is recorded as declared but not executed, and `target.environment` as declared but not
resolved.
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-190-| An enabled gating or required judge | Refused before anything runs |
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-191-| An advisory judge (including the hosted default) | Not run; the report says so |
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-192-| `suppressedSuiteStandardCheckIds` | Refused — a local run has no suite-standard regist
ry |
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-193-
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md:194:Every selected case is checked before any model or tool call, so an unsupported later ca
se costs nothing. Hosted-only capabilities run with `mcpjam cloud eval run --file <file>`.
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-195-
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-196-## Output
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-197-
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-198-* With `--format human` (the default on a terminal), a summary: the verdict, each case's
gradeable-iteration count against its threshold, failing assertions, not-measured iterations, policy blocks and un-run judges.
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-211-| `0` | The run completed and its decision passed |
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-212-| `1` | The run completed and its decision failed — the only source of `1` |
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-213-| `2` | Invalid file or flags, an unsupported local capability, an import/approval refus
